directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a letter to a foreign friend who wants to study in China. Please recommend a university to him. You should write at least 120 words but no more than] 80 words
sample_essay:
Dear [Friend's Name],

I'm thrilled to hear that you're considering studying in China. I'd like to recommend Peking University to you.

To begin with, Peking University has a long-standing reputation for academic excellence. It offers a wide range of high-quality courses in various fields, such as literature, science, and engineering. Many world-renowned scholars teach there, so you'll have the opportunity to learn from the best. 

In addition, the campus environment is beautiful and full of historical and cultural heritage. The ancient buildings and lush gardens create a peaceful and inspiring atmosphere for learning. 

Furthermore, the university has a vibrant international community. You can make friends from all over the world and experience different cultures, which will broaden your horizons.

In conclusion, Peking University is an ideal place for you to pursue your studies in China. I hope you'll consider my recommendation.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
